title: Evidently diverse effects of silver nanoparticles on Vibrio parahaemolyticus across different estuarine water samples
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,2657-2666
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00018A, Paper
Qianqian Yang, Xiangyi Hou, Feng Lu, Dahai Zhang, Wentao Lin, Nick Schlensky, Zhixiang Chen, Yan Zhang, Xuzhi Zhang
Growth curves of surviving bacterial cells show that MICs of Ag NPs against V. parahaemolyticus varied greatly in different estuarine water samples. The antibacterial effectiveness depends on the combination of physicochemical parameters.
